weights_simplex.note: CSFR rank on the exploratory auditability composite over the full weight simplex

interpretation: ARC is the only component on which CSFR is uniquely maximal, because only its implementation emitted an audit record in this study. Wherever w3>0 that component lifts CSFR unless another method's CVR/HRP advantage outweighs it; the rank range records where that happens. The composite describes the evaluated software artefacts and is not a forensic-validity scale.
